'''Tauk''' was a [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Royal Guard]] who served [[Darth Sidious]] and was stationed with another [[Unidentified Red Guard (Death Star II)|Royal Guard]]. Tauk perished when his other guard shot at him after the guard betrayed the [[Galactic Empire]] after learning that their leader, Sidious, had been [[Death|killed]].<ref name="FACPOV" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Lemmet Tauk]] was a close friend of [[Kir Kanos]], who had killed him during his training at the [[Imperial Royal Guard Academy]].<ref name="ce 2">[[Crimson Empire 2|''Crimson Empire'' 2]]</ref>
